title: DeltaReplay: Task-Relative Memory Reuse for Mobile GUI Agents

paragraphs.en: Memory-augmented mobile GUI agents store successful execution trajectories and reuse them in later tasks, but a stored trajectory rarely matches a new task exactly. The new task may use different parameters, share only some of its steps with a stored trajectory, or have no relevant record in memory. Forcing the agent to use irrelevant memory can mislead it, whereas discarding memory that may still be useful deprives it of guidance from past experience. To address this dilemma, we propose DeltaReplay, a step-level memory reuse framework that decides how to use existing memory without modifying it. We observe that the reusable part of a stored record is determined not by the record itself but by its relation to the new task, mainly through two factors: page-level consistency and action-level generality. We therefore store execution trajectories as paths in a transition graph, whose nodes (pages) and edges (actions between pages) capture these two factors. At reuse time, the action on each edge is split into a task-independent operation and task-specific parameters. DeltaReplay then compares each recorded step with the new task and the current screen, and decides whether to follow it, execute it after replacing its parameters, or leave it to the base agent. On AndroidWorld and SPA-Bench, DeltaReplay improves the task success rate over a base agent with the same backbone by up to 10.3 and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. These results indicate that deciding at each step how to use retrieved memory lets agents benefit even from partially matching trajectories.

paragraphs.en: However, a stored trajectory rarely fits a new task exactly. The new task may use different parameters, such as another contact or amount, or share only some of its steps with the stored task, and frequent app updates can change the screens on which recorded actions were taken ( 42matters, 2026 ; McIlroy et al., 2016 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . Retrieving the right memory is thus only the beginning of using it: the agent must still decide, at each step, which of these cases applies.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，存储的轨迹很少能完全匹配新任务。 新任务可能使用不同的参数，例如另一种接触方式或数量，也可能仅与存储的任务共享部分步骤；此外，频繁的应用程序更新可能会改变记录操作所执行的界面（42matters, 2026；McIlroy 等, 2016；Lu 等, 2025）。 因此，检索到的步骤可能如记录般可执行，但只有在当前界面上重新定位后才有用，也可能完全不适用；每种情况都需要不同的处理方式：重播、重新定位或丢弃。 因此，检索正确的记忆只是使用它的开始：智能体仍然必须在每一步决定上述哪种情况适用。

paragraphs.en: Most memory-augmented GUI agents support only some of these uses, and fix them in advance (Table 1 ): some always add retrieved memory to the prompt ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , some choose only between executing a stored step and discarding it ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Mi et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , and some choose only between re-grounding and discarding ( Chai et al., 2026 ) . Each missing use causes a kind of loss. (i) Slow reuse: replayable steps are still reasoned through. Reasoning through a step is slow; GUI-explorer, for example, reports 66 s per step with GPT-4o ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . Yet agents that add memory to the prompt, or re-ground every step, do so even for steps that could be replayed as recorded. Replaying them saves this time: on AndroidWorld tasks whose exact goal is already in memory, our method replays about half of the steps and takes 9.3 s per step, against 19.0–32.2 s for prompting-based memory baselines (Section 5.3 ). (ii) Over-discarding: partly usable memory is dropped as a whole. Execute-or-discard agents check whether a record can be used before reusing it, for example by asking an LLM whether a shortcut’s preconditions hold ( Wang et al., 2025a ) or whether the record applies ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , or by matching elements in the UI hierarchy ( Liu et al., 2025 ) ; a record that passes is executed as a whole, and one that fails is discarded as a whole. Yet a record often differs from the new task in only a few steps, for example in one typed value or one target label. For such a record, deciding on the whole record is wrong either way: accepting it executes the old parameters as recorded, and rejecting it also throws away the steps that could still be followed. In our experiments, records of the same template that differ from the task only in parameters solve 9.1% of the tasks when replayed verbatim, and ignoring them leaves the base agent at 63.6%, whereas following their matching steps and replacing only their parameters reaches 86.4% (Section 5.5 ). (iii) Misuse: inapplicable memory is still applied. LLM agents may reproduce retrieved experience even when it does not correspond to the current task ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) ; in an ablation of Darwinian Memory, searching memory with subtasks keyed by the task goal alone lowers AndroidWorld success to 29.7%, 11.3 percentage points below the 41.0% obtained without memory ( Mi et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大多数具有记忆增强功能的 GUI 智能体仅支持其中部分用途，且这些用途是预先固定的（表 1）：有些智能体总是将检索到的记忆添加到提示中（Xie 等，2025；Chen 等，2025b；Guan 等，2025；Sun 等，2026），有些仅在执行已存储的步骤与丢弃该步骤之间进行选择（Jiang 等，2025；Mi 等，2026；Liu 等，2025），还有一些仅在重新锚定与丢弃之间进行选择（Chai 等，2026）。 每种缺失的用途都会导致某种形式的损失。 （i）重复使用缓慢：可重播的步骤仍需经过推理过程。 对步骤进行推理的过程非常缓慢；例如，GUI-explorer 在使用 GPT-4o 时报告每个步骤需要 66 秒（Xie 等，2025）。 然而，那些将记忆添加到提示中或为每个步骤重新锚定的智能体，即使对于可以按记录重播的步骤，也会执行这些操作。 重播这些步骤可以节省时间：在 AndroidWorld 任务中，当确切目标已在记忆中时，我们的方法会重播约一半的步骤，且每个步骤仅需 9.3 秒，而基于提示的记忆基线方法则需要 19.0–32.2 秒（第 5.3 节）。 （ii）过度丢弃：部分可用的记忆会被整体丢弃。 “执行或丢弃”型智能体在重复使用记录前会检查其是否可用，例如通过询问 LLM 某个快捷方式的先决条件是否满足（Wang 等，2025a），或该记录是否适用（Jiang 等，2025），或者通过匹配 UI 层级中的元素（Liu 等，2025）；通过检查的记录会被整体执行，而失败记录则会被整体丢弃。 然而，一个记录通常与新任务仅在少数步骤上存在差异，例如仅在一个输入值或一个目标标签上不同。 对于这样的记录，无论做出何种决定都是错误的：接受它意味着按记录执行旧参数，而拒绝它则会同时丢弃那些仍然可以遵循的步骤。 在我们的实验中，与任务仅在参数上不同的相同模板记录，在逐字重播时能解决 9.1% 的任务；忽略这些记录时，基础智能体的成功率为 63.6%，而遵循其匹配步骤并仅替换参数则能达到 86.4%（第 5.5 节）。 （iii）误用：不适用的记忆仍会被应用。 LLM 智能体可能会重复使用检索到的经验，即使该经验与当前任务并不对应（Xiong 等，2026）；在“达尔文记忆”模型的一个消融实验中，仅以任务目标为键在记忆中搜索子任务，导致 AndroidWorld 的成功率降至 29.7%，比不使用记忆时获得的 41.0% 低了 11.3 个百分点（Mi 等，2026）。

A record’s reusable steps depend on the new task and the current screen, so they can only be decided step by step at use time. We therefore present DeltaReplay, which makes the most of existing memory without modifying it and chooses among the three uses at every step (Figure 2 ). Route A (replay) executes the recorded step once a structural check confirms that the screen matches, the recorded target maps to a current element, and the step carries no parameters of the old task. Route B (re-ground) handles a step that applies but cannot be executed as recorded: it replaces the parameters the step carries from the old task with those of the current task (Figure 1 ). Route C (discard) leaves the step to the base agent when no recorded step applies. Route A addresses failure (i), Route B failure (ii), and Route C failure (iii). To choose a route, DeltaReplay stores trajectories as paths of a transition graph and retrieves them by task identity. It separates each step’s reusable operation (which page to open, which button to tap) from the parameters it carries from the old task: names, dates, and amounts, as well as answers and when to finish. It matches the current step structurally (can it be executed as recorded?) and, only when the current screen has no matching position in the record, semantically (which recorded step comes next?), with an option to reject all candidates.

paragraphs.en: We identify three failure modes of memory reuse in GUI agents (slow reuse of replayable steps, over-discarding of partly usable memory, and misuse of inapplicable memory) and trace them mostly to one cause: existing methods treat a memory as a whole, whereas reusability varies across the steps of the same memory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出 GUI 智能体中内存重用的三种失败模式（可重播步骤的缓慢重用、部分可用内存的过度丢弃以及不适用内存的误用），并发现这些失败主要源于一个原因：现有方法将内存视为一个整体，而实际上同一内存中不同步骤的重用性存在差异。

paragraphs.en: We propose DeltaReplay, which organizes execution trajectories as a transition graph, splits the action on each edge at reuse time into a task-independent operation and task-specific parameters, and chooses at each step among replay, re-grounding, and discard according to whether the screen matches and whether the parameters must be replaced.

paragraphs.en: On 176 tasks from AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) and SPA-Bench ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , DeltaReplay improves the task success rate over a base agent with the same backbone by 7.8–10.3 and 16.6–25.0 percentage points, respectively, and outperforms two memory baselines on AndroidWorld; it cuts per-step latency by up to 57% when the task is already in memory and shows no measurable loss when memory does not apply. Ablations show that verification and discarding are necessary, and route statistics and a step-level annotation characterize how each route is used.

paragraphs.en: Memory for GUI agents. Prior work stores exploration and app memories ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , workflows ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , page graphs and page memories ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Kong et al., 2025 ) , transition-aware knowledge ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , state machines and knowledge graphs ( Zhong et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Chai et al., 2026 ; Qin et al., 2026 ) , memory trees ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , demonstrations ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , element-level functional memory ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , structured, latent, or self-evolving experience ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and tips and shortcuts ( Wang et al., 2025a ) ; MemGUI-Bench evaluates such memories ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . The closest to ours is MAGNET, which separates what stays stable in memory from what changes by linking the varying appearances of a UI element to its stable function and abstracting similar trajectories into workflows with placeholders ( Sun et al., 2026 ) ; this separation, however, is made when the memory is built, and the retrieved elements and workflows only serve as references in the prompt. Overall, these works focus on what to store and how to organize and retrieve it; a retrieved memory is then usually used as a whole, placed in the context or executed in full, and which of its parts fit the new task is rarely judged on its own.

paragraphs.en: How retrieved memory enters the decision. Retrieval alone does not settle how its results should be used: in retrieval-augmented generation, CRAG refines, discards, or supplements retrieved documents per query ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . In GUI agents, one family uses memory as context: the model reasons over retrieved records, workflows, or knowledge in its prompt at every step ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , with refinements that drop untrusted memory blocks through a learned trust gate ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , let the agent decide when to retrieve ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) , or turn retrieved cases into support for the current candidate actions ( Zhang & Zheng, 2027 ) . Another family executes memory in units. Mobile-Agent-E reuses shortcuts with preconditions and arguments ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , AppAgentX lets an LLM decide whether a high-level action applies and fill in its arguments ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , and Darwinian Memory replays whole subtask units indexed by precondition and goal ( Mi et al., 2026 ) . MobiMem records fine-grained interaction sequences to reduce reliance on model inference ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , AgentRR selects experience at different levels of abstraction at run time ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , and EAM extracts an executable path from a knowledge graph and lets an LLM replace its parameters in a single pass before execution ( Qin et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent EchoPath turns validated trajectories into callable procedures that rebind only inputs declared in advance and are invoked only when they can be replayed deterministically ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . UI-KOBE uses an app graph as guidance: when the current screen is matched to one of its nodes, it chooses among the transitions of that node ( Chai et al., 2026 ) . Both families, however, decide at the level of a whole memory or a predefined unit: the first leaves the choice of which part to use to the model without any check, and the second fixes which parts may vary when the memory is built or the unit is invoked, whereas reusability varies from step to step and with the new task.
paragraphs.zh: 检索到的记忆如何进入决策过程。 仅靠检索本身无法确定其结果应如何使用：在检索增强生成中，CRAG 会根据每个查询对检索到的文档进行精炼、舍弃或补充（Yan et al., 2024）。 在 GUI 智能体中，一类方法将记忆用作上下文：模型在每一步都会基于提示中的检索记录、工作流程或知识进行推理（Xie et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025b；Guan et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026），并通过学习到的信任门控机制丢弃不可信的记忆块，允许智能体自行决定何时进行检索，或将检索到的案例转化为对当前候选行动的支撑（Zhang et al., 2026b；Zhao et al., 2026a；Zhang & Zheng, 2027）。 另一类方法则以单元形式执行记忆。 Mobile-Agent-E 会复用带有前提条件和参数的快捷方式（Wang et al., 2025a）；AppAgentX 允许大型语言模型判断某项高层级行动是否适用并填充其参数（Jiang et al., 2025）；而 Darwinian Memory 则会重播以前提条件和目标为索引的完整子任务单元（Mi et al., 2026）。 MobiMem 记录精细粒度的交互序列，以减少对模型推理的依赖（Liu et al., 2025）；AgentRR 在运行时选择不同抽象层级的经验（Feng et al., 2025）；EAM 则从知识图谱中提取可执行路径，并允许大型语言模型在执行前一次性替换其中的参数（Qin et al., 2026）。 Concurrent EchoPath 将经过验证的路径转化为可调用程序，这些程序仅重新绑定预先声明的输入，且仅在能够确定性地重播时才会被调用（Zhao et al., 2026b）。 UI-KOBE 以应用图为指导：当当前屏幕与图中的某个节点匹配时，它便在该节点的转换选项中进行选择（Chai et al., 2026）。 然而，这两类方法都是在整个记忆或预定义单元层面做出决策：第一类方法将使用哪部分记忆的选择完全交给模型，且没有任何检查机制；第二类方法则在构建记忆或调用单元时固定了哪些部分可以变化，而可重用性则因步骤和任务的不同而有所差异。

sents.zh: Concurrent EchoPath 将经过验证的路径转化为可调用程序，这些程序仅重新绑定预先声明的输入，且仅在能够确定性地重播时才会被调用（Zhao et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: UI-KOBE uses an app graph as guidance: when the current screen is matched to one of its nodes, it chooses among the transitions of that node ( Chai et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: UI-KOBE 以应用图为指导：当当前屏幕与图中的某个节点匹配时，它便在该节点的转换选项中进行选择（Chai et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Both families, however, decide at the level of a whole memory or a predefined unit: the first leaves the choice of which part to use to the model without any check, and the second fixes which parts may vary when the memory is built or the unit is invoked, whereas reusability varies from step to step and with the new task.
sents.zh: 然而，这两类方法都是在整个记忆或预定义单元层面做出决策：第一类方法将使用哪部分记忆的选择完全交给模型，且没有任何检查机制；第二类方法则在构建记忆或调用单元时固定了哪些部分可以变化，而可重用性则因步骤和任务的不同而有所差异。

paragraphs.en: Recorded interactions under change. Records become outdated as apps change: app graphs must be repaired or re-explored after major UI updates ( Chai et al., 2026 ) , and GUI testing repairs recorded test scripts for new app versions ( Pan et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2021 ) or migrates tests across apps by semantic matching of GUI events ( Behrang & Orso, 2019 ; Lin et al., 2019 ) , which remains imperfect ( Mariani et al., 2021 ) . These approaches repair a record before reusing it, at the cost of extra device interaction and model calls; DeltaReplay instead keeps the record fixed and decides at each step which of its steps still hold.
paragraphs.zh: 在变化背景下记录下来的交互。 随着应用程序的变化，记录会变得过时：在重大用户界面更新后，必须修复或重新探索应用图（Chai 等，2026），而 GUI 测试则会为新版本的应用程序修复已记录好的测试脚本（Pan 等，2022；Xu 等，2021），或通过语义匹配 GUI 事件将测试迁移到不同应用程序之间（Behrang & Orso，2019；Lin 等，2019），但这种方法仍存在不足（Mariani 等，2021）。 这些方法在重新使用记录之前会先对其进行修复，但需要付出额外的设备交互和模型调用的代价；而 DeltaReplay 则保持记录的固定性，并在每一步决定其中哪些步骤仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks and memory. AndroidWorld-116 contains one instance of each of the 116 task templates of AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) . Its memory holds 42 successful runs of the Qwen3.8-Flash base agent on other instances, one for each of 42 templates, recorded before evaluation; the other 74 templates have no record, and both backbones use this memory (Appendix D ), so DeltaReplay with Qwen3-VL-30B replays runs of the stronger Qwen3.8-Flash. We group the test tasks by the closest record in memory: same task ( n = 20 n{=}20 ), a record of the same template with the same goal text; same template ( n = 22 n{=}22 ), a record of the template with other parameters; same app ( n = 48 n{=}48 ), records of other tasks of the same app only; and none ( n = 26 n{=}26 ), no record of the app. SPA-Bench-60 contains 60 tasks drawn at random from the 150 Chinese single-app tasks of SPA-Bench ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , after excluding tasks with real-world side effects (payment, social, meeting, and hospital apps) and tasks our phone cannot run (Appendix D ); all run on a physical phone. SPA-Bench tasks come in families of three, each extending the previous one. Its memory is the union of the successful base-agent runs of both backbones on our SPA-Bench task pool, 50 runs of 42 tasks (27 of them in SPA-Bench-60), so each backbone can also replay runs of the other; the groups are same task ( n = 27 n{=}27 ), a record of the task itself; same family ( n = 15 n{=}15 ), a record of an easier task of the same family, which shares the first steps; and no family record ( n = 18 n{=}18 ), no record of the task or of an easier task of its family (12 of these tasks’ apps hold records of other families). The agent is not given the group label, but it retrieves records by the benchmark’s task identifiers (Section 4.1 ), so the kind of record an episode receives follows its group, and the selector prompt names that kind (Appendix C ).

paragraphs.en: Backbones and baselines. We use Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , a vision-language mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with about 30B total and 3B activated parameters, which reads the screenshot and the UI tree, and Qwen3.8-Flash ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , the production version of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, an MoE model with 125B parameters (6B activated per token). The base agent uses the same backbone, prompts, and candidate-action interface as DeltaReplay, without memory. GUI-Owl is GUI-Owl-1.5 ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , a native GUI agent model without memory. RAG-prompting adds the records most similar to the current task and screen to the base agent’s prompt; GUI-explorer ( Xie et al., 2025 ) mines transition-aware knowledge, i.e., what an action does, and our adaptation injects the per-step entries most similar to the current task and screen into the prompt. Both use Qwen3.8-Flash and the same memory as DeltaReplay (Appendix E ).

paragraphs.en: Metrics. We report task success rate (SR) and latency (Lat.), the mean wall-clock time per executed step, excluding the time spent on the device (Appendix B ). Success is decided by an LLM judge for all methods: the single-app evaluator of SPA-Bench ( Chen et al., 2025a ) with Qwen3.8-Flash as the judge model, which reads the screenshots of the episode. We use the same judge on both benchmarks because SPA-Bench has no rule-based checkers; on the AndroidWorld tasks whose checkers work in our harness, those checkers agree with our success labels on 91.5% of the episodes (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 我们报告任务成功率（SR）和延迟（Lat.），即每次执行步骤的平均实际耗时，不包括设备上的时间（附录 B）。 所有方法的成功与否均由 LLM 裁判决定：使用 SPA-Bench 的单应用评估器（Chen et al., 2025a），并以 Qwen3.8-Flash 作为裁判模型，该模型会读取整个流程的屏幕截图。 我们在两个基准测试中都使用了相同的裁判，因为 SPA-Bench 没有基于规则的检查器；在 AndroidWorld 任务中，其检查器可以在我们的运行环境中正常工作，并且这些检查器与我们对成功与否的标注在 91.5% 的流程中保持一致（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: Run-to-run variation. Each task is run once per method, and decoding through the cloud APIs is not fully deterministic. On the 26 AndroidWorld tasks whose app has no record in memory ( none ), DeltaReplay retrieves nothing and acts through the base agent at every step, yet its success differs from the base agent’s by one task with each backbone and its latency by 2.1 s (Qwen3-VL-30B) and 4.1 s (Qwen3.8-Flash) per step (Table 3 ). We therefore regard differences of about one task per group, or about 2–4 s per step, as within run-to-run variation.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows that DeltaReplay achieves the highest success rate on both benchmarks. With the same backbone, it improves over the base agent by 10.3 (Qwen3-VL-30B) and 7.8 points (Qwen3.8-Flash) on AndroidWorld and by 25.0 and 16.6 points on SPA-Bench. Both memory baselines use the same records but fall below the base agent in success (41.4% and 47.4% vs. 49.1%), and RAG-prompting is the slowest agent (34.8 s per step). DeltaReplay also surpasses GUI-Owl-1.5 (50.9%), a model trained for GUI control, with either general-purpose backbone.

paragraphs.en: Memory covers the task. On AndroidWorld (Table 3 ), DeltaReplay gains the most when memory holds the same task or template. With Qwen3.8-Flash on these 42 tasks, only DeltaReplay solves 8 and only the base agent solves 1 (exact McNemar test, p = 0.039 p=0.039 ; Appendix I ). paragraphs.en: Memory covers nothing applicable. When memory holds only other tasks of the same app, or nothing from the app, the right decision is mostly to discard. paragraphs.en: Table 7 (Appendix G ) shows that DeltaReplay uses memory in proportion to coverage. With no record of the app, every step is discarded.

paragraphs.en: To check whether routed steps are correct, an LLM judge (Claude Fable 5.1), blind to the route, labeled 150 executed steps, 50 per route (Appendix H ). Route A and Route B steps reach a precision of 83.7% and 78.0% (Table 8 ), compared with 75.5% for Route C steps; with about 50 steps per route, these differences are within sampling error (95% intervals of about ± \pm 10–12 points). Route A and Route B steps also contain fewer harmful actions (2 and 3 vs. 6), although Route C also handles the harder steps where no memory applies. Most of their errors are no-ops, such as tapping a target clipped off-screen, which waste a step but leave the task recoverable. Within Route B, parameter-adapted steps are almost always correct (19 of 20), whereas borrowed steps are harder (20 of 30).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检查路由步骤是否正确，一个对路线一无所知的 LLM 裁判（Claude Fable 5.1）对 150 个已执行步骤进行了标注，每条路线各 50 步（附录 H）。 路线 A 和路线 B 的步骤精确度分别达到 83.7% 和 78.0%（表 8），而路线 C 的步骤精确度为 75.5%；考虑到每条路线约有 50 步，这些差异在采样误差范围内（95% 置信区间约为 ±\pm 10–12 个百分点）。 路线 A 和路线 B 的步骤中有害操作也更少（分别为 2 次和 3 次，对比 6 次），尽管路线 C 也处理了那些无法使用记忆功能的更难步骤。 它们的大多数错误都是无效操作，例如点击一个被截出屏幕的目标，这类操作会浪费一步，但任务仍可以恢复。 在路线 B 中，经过参数调整的步骤几乎总是正确的（20 步中有 19 步），而借用步骤则更难成功（30 步中有 20 步）。

paragraphs.en: In Table 4 , we remove parts of the routing decision. Unchecked replay fails. Executing records verbatim, without the screen check, target mapping, parameter adaptation, or fallback, solves only 9.1% of same-template tasks: the records are correct for their own instance but wrong for this one. Verification and discarding are necessary. Without Route C and the screen check, the best memory candidate is always executed and success falls to 45.5%, below the base agent; in the same-app group, dropping the screen check and the selector lets Route B take 73% of the steps and lowers success to 20.0%: applicability must be decided before re-grounding. Replay saves computation. The full system uses 1.00 model calls per step on same-template tasks, less than half of the base agent’s 2.11. When memory rarely applies (same app), matching adds 0.16 calls per step.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 4 中，我们移除了部分路由决策。未经检查的重放会失败。 逐字执行记录，但不进行屏幕检查、目标映射、参数适配或回退，仅能解决 9.1% 的相同模板任务：这些记录对其自身实例是正确的，但在此实例中却是错误的。 验证和丢弃是必要的。 如果没有路线 C 和屏幕检查，最佳记忆候选项总会被执行，成功率会降至 45.5%，低于基础智能体；在相同应用组中，移除屏幕检查和选择器后，路线 B 将占据 73% 的步骤，而成功率则降至 20.0%：在重新接地之前必须决定适用性。 重放可以节省计算资源。 完整系统在相同模板任务中每步使用 1.00 次模型调用，不到基础智能体 2.11 次的一半。 当记忆很少适用时（相同应用），匹配会增加每步 0.16 次调用。

paragraphs.en: DeltaReplay chooses for each retrieved step whether to replay it, re-ground it, or discard it, instead of supporting only some of these uses. On AndroidWorld and SPA-Bench, this choice improves success over same-backbone base agents, can make the agent faster when memory covers the task, and avoids the losses that prompting-based memory suffers when memory does not fit.
paragraphs.zh: DeltaReplay 为每个检索到的步骤选择是重播、重新接地还是丢弃它，而不是仅支持这些用法中的部分。 在 AndroidWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上，这种选择在成功率上优于相同主干结构的基线智能体，当内存覆盖任务时可以使智能体运行得更快，并且避免了提示式记忆在内存不足时所遭受的损失。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. First, a recorded step may also fail to apply because its target has moved or disappeared, for example after an app update ( Lu et al., 2025 ) . DeltaReplay leaves such steps to the base agent, and our evaluation does not vary the app version. Second, Route B finds the values to replace by aligning the two task descriptions word by word, so a value that the instruction only implies, such as a date given as “tomorrow”, is also left to the base agent. Third, records are retrieved by the benchmark’s task identifiers, as this work studies how retrieved records are used. Retrieving them from the instruction alone is left to future work. Finally, task success is decided by an LLM judge, and the step-level labels come from another LLM (Claude Fable 5.1); neither has been checked by humans.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 首先，某个已记录的步骤也可能无法应用，因为其目标可能已经移动或消失，例如在应用程序更新之后（Lu et al., 2025）。 DeltaReplay 将此类步骤留给基础智能体处理，且我们的评估并未改变应用程序版本。 其次，路线 B 通过逐字对齐两个任务描述来找到需要替换的值，因此，指令中仅隐含的值（例如以“明天”形式给出的日期）也需要由基础智能体自行处理。 第三，记录是通过基准测试的任务标识符进行检索的，因为本研究旨在探讨已检索记录的用途。 仅通过指令本身来检索这些记录则留待未来研究。 最后，任务的成功与否由一个 LLM 裁判决定，而步骤级别的标签则来自另一个 LLM（Claude Fable 5.1）；两者均未经过人工验证。

paragraphs.en: This work studies memory reuse for mobile GUI agents. Reliable reuse can reduce manual effort for routine phone tasks and help users who find small touch interfaces hard to operate, but more capable GUI automation also carries risks: unintended actions in sensitive apps, handling of private data, and unauthorized automation. Our experiments use benchmark tasks, run SPA-Bench on the authors’ own app accounts, and involve no human subjects; memory stores no data of other users, and the recorded screens, which may show the authors’ account data, are not released. Deployed systems should confirm sensitive actions with the user, log agent actions, and avoid storing private information in memory without consent.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了移动 GUI 智能体的内存重用问题。 可靠的内存重用可以减少日常手机操作的体力劳动，并帮助那些认为小尺寸触摸界面难以操作的用户；但更强大的 GUI 自动化也存在风险：在敏感应用中执行意外操作、处理私人数据以及未经授权的自动化行为。 我们的实验使用了基准任务，在作者自己的应用账户上运行了 SPA-Bench，且未涉及任何人类受试者；内存不会存储其他用户的数据，而可能显示作者账户信息的屏幕记录也不会被公开。 已部署的系统应在执行敏感操作前向用户确认，记录智能体的操作，并避免未经同意将私人信息存储在内存中。

paragraphs.en: Per-step pipeline. At each step the agent dumps the UI tree, converts it into an HTML-like description, builds the candidate action set, and records an annotated screenshot. Screens are compared with three similarities: cosine similarity (of bge-small-zh-v1.5 embeddings of the visible text of the HTML-like descriptions), structural overlap (Jaccard overlap of the two screens’ widget-structure sets), and fuzzy-matching similarity (rapidfuzz fuzzy text ratio, 0–100). Two screens match when both the cosine and the structural score reach their thresholds, or when the fuzzy-matching score alone is at least 80. While following a record we use loose thresholds (cosine ≥ 0.60 \geq 0.60 , structural ≥ 0.70 \geq 0.70 ); when searching the record for a new matching position we use strict thresholds (cosine ≥ 0.65 \geq 0.65 , structural ≥ 0.80 \geq 0.80 ). When the current screen has no matching position in the record, at most K = 8 K=8 candidate steps are kept (each action at a given recorded step is kept only once); the selector receives the goal, the task history, the current HTML, and each candidate step as its recorded action with the text on the element it operates on (Appendix C ), and returns one candidate or rejects all. An episode ends after max ⁡ ( 8 , ⌈ 3 ​ n ref ⌉ ) \max(8,\lceil 3\,n_{\mathrm{ref}}\rceil) steps, where n ref n_{\mathrm{ref}} is the reference step count of the task; on AndroidWorld it is also capped at 15 minutes. All backbones decode at temperature 0, and Qwen3.8-Flash runs in thinking mode. Decoding through the cloud APIs is not fully deterministic, so repeated runs of the same policy can differ; each task is run once per method (Section 5.1 ). If the selector rejects all candidates, the mapping fails, or Adapt \mathrm{Adapt} abstains, the base agent acts on the same candidate set.

The prompt of π base \pi_{\mathrm{base}} , which Route C also uses, gives the user goal, the history of actions, the HTML-like description of the current screen, and the candidate actions, each with an index and a JSON description. paragraphs.en: AndroidWorld-116. One instance of each of the 116 AndroidWorld task templates forms the test set. Before evaluation, the Qwen3.8-Flash base agent ran on other instances of the templates, generated with a different random seed. Memory keeps every successful run, except runs that repeat the same action three or more times in a row (six for scrolls) or wait in more than 40% of their steps: 42 of 49 successful runs, one each for 42 templates. It is frozen before evaluation and shared by both backbones and both memory baselines. Coverage groups are defined by the closest record memory holds for the task: same task (a record with the same goal text, from another instance of the template), same template (a record of the template with other parameters), same app (no record of the template, but records of other tasks of the same app), and none (no record of the app). The same-task and same-template groups therefore contain only templates the base agent solved at least once.
paragraphs.zh: AndroidWorld-116。 116个AndroidWorld任务模板中的每个模板各取一个实例，共同构成测试集。 在评估之前，Qwen3.8-Flash基础智能体在其他模板实例上运行，这些实例是使用不同随机种子生成的。 记忆模块会保留每次成功运行的记录，但重复执行同一动作三次或更多次（滚动操作为六次）的运行，或在超过40%的步骤中等待的运行除外：49次成功运行中有42次被保留，每个模板各保留一次。 该模块在评估前被冻结，并由两个主干模型和两种记忆基线共享。 覆盖组由记忆模块为该任务保留的最接近记录定义：同一任务（来自模板另一实例、具有相同目标文本的记录）、同一模板（具有其他参数的该模板记录）、同一应用（没有该模板的记录，但有该应用其他任务的记录），以及无匹配项（没有该应用的任何记录）。 因此，同一任务和同一模板组仅包含基础智能体至少成功解决过一次的任务模板。

paragraphs.en: SPA-Bench-60. The 60 tasks are drawn from the 150 Chinese single-app tasks of SPA-Bench. We exclude tasks with real-world side effects: Alipay (payments), WeChat (posts), Tencent Meeting (real meetings), a hospital app, and one QQ Music task that shares to a WeChat contact. We hold out 17 tasks as an unused reserve and exclude tasks our phone cannot run: Huawei Browser is not available, China Telecom tasks need an account we do not have, and JD shows a CAPTCHA at every launch. We also exclude tasks that do not complete a run within a fixed retry budget and three tasks without a complete base-agent run. From the remaining 84 tasks we draw 60 at random with a fixed seed, stratified over three strata of our task pool (19/30/11 tasks), which are unrelated to the coverage groups; two apps that show a login or verification wall on our phone (Haodaifu, Meituan) are dropped with all their tasks, which are replaced in a random order fixed in advance. SPA-Bench tasks come in families of three that extend each other, so a run of an easier task shares the first steps of a harder one. Memory is the union of the successful base-agent runs of both backbones on our SPA-Bench task pool, which also contains tasks outside SPA-Bench-60. The same task group is the set of tasks at least one backbone solved when memory was built (Qwen3.8-Flash solved 24 of these 27, Qwen3-VL-30B 14). The same family group holds tasks whose own run is not in memory but an easier task of the same family is. The no family record group holds tasks for which neither the task nor an easier task of its family is in memory; 12 of its 18 tasks belong to apps with records of other families. Of the 33 tasks in the last two groups, 32 were failed by both backbones when memory was built, so base-agent SR there is low by construction. Tables 6 and 6 list the tasks of each group.

paragraphs.en: Task success. Both benchmarks and all methods use the same judge, the single-app evaluator of SPA-Bench ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , with PaddleOCR for screen text and Qwen3.8-Flash as the judge model. The judge receives the screenshot of every executed step with the executed action drawn on it, and a final screenshot taken 3 s after the last action; when an episode has more than 10 screenshots, the earlier ones are summarized in batches of 10, and the judge receives the summaries and the last 10 screenshots. It returns success or failure. We do not apply SPA-Bench’s key-component check, which requires given UI strings to appear on screen, because these strings were collected on older app versions. Each episode is judged once, whether or not the agent declared completion; an episode stopped by a time limit without a verdict counts as a failure. AndroidWorld’s rule-based checkers are recorded but not used for scoring. In our setup they cannot score 41 of the 116 tasks. The checkers of 25 question-answering tasks read the agent’s answer through AndroidWorld’s own environment loop, in which our agents do not run; the checkers of the other 16 read the screen through that loop, require the task’s app to still be in the foreground although our harness closes the apps before they run, or check a file rename that our task descriptions do not ask for. On the other 75 tasks, the checkers agree with our success labels on 91.5% (248/271) of the episodes of GUI-Owl, RAG-prompting, GUI-explorer, and DeltaReplay (Qwen3.8-Flash).
paragraphs.zh: 任务成功。 所有基准测试和所有方法均使用相同的评判者，即 SPA-Bench 的单应用评估器（Chen et al., 2025a），其中 PaddleOCR 用于识别屏幕文本，Qwen3.8-Flash 作为评判模型。 评判者会接收每一步执行操作时的截图（其中标注了已执行的操作），以及最后操作执行 3 秒后拍摄的最终截图；若一个回合的截图超过 10 张，则前 10 张截图会被分批次汇总，评判者将收到这些摘要及最后 10 张截图。 系统会返回成功或失败的结果。 我们没有应用 SPA-Bench 的关键组件检查机制，该机制要求指定的 UI 字符串必须出现在屏幕上，因为这些字符串是在旧版本应用中收集的。 每个回合仅被评判一次，无论智能体是否声明完成；若回合因时间限制终止且未得出评判结果，则计为失败。 AndroidWorld 的规则 기반 检查器已被记录，但未用于评分。 在我们的设置中，这些检查器无法对 116 个任务中的 41 个进行评分。 25 个问答任务的检查器通过 AndroidWorld 自身的环境循环读取智能体的答案（我们的智能体并未在该循环中运行）；其余 16 个任务的检查器则通过该循环读取屏幕，要求任务对应的应用仍保持在前台（尽管我们的工具会在智能体运行前关闭这些应用），或检查任务描述中未要求的文件重命名操作。 在其余 75 个任务中，对于 GUI-Owl、RAG-prompting、GUI-explorer 和 DeltaReplay（Qwen3.8-Flash）的回合，这些检查器与我们的成功标签一致的比例为 91.5%（248/271）。

sents.en: It returns success or failure.
sents.zh: 系统会返回成功或失败的结果。

sents.en: We do not apply SPA-Bench’s key-component check, which requires given UI strings to appear on screen, because these strings were collected on older app versions.
sents.zh: 我们没有应用 SPA-Bench 的关键组件检查机制，该机制要求指定的 UI 字符串必须出现在屏幕上，因为这些字符串是在旧版本应用中收集的。

sents.en: Each episode is judged once, whether or not the agent declared completion; an episode stopped by a time limit without a verdict counts as a failure.
sents.zh: 每个回合仅被评判一次，无论智能体是否声明完成；若回合因时间限制终止且未得出评判结果，则计为失败。

sents.en: In our setup they cannot score 41 of the 116 tasks.
sents.zh: 在我们的设置中，这些检查器无法对 116 个任务中的 41 个进行评分。

sents.en: The checkers of 25 question-answering tasks read the agent’s answer through AndroidWorld’s own environment loop, in which our agents do not run; the checkers of the other 16 read the screen through that loop, require the task’s app to still be in the foreground although our harness closes the apps before they run, or check a file rename that our task descriptions do not ask for.

paragraphs.en: RAG-prompting. The Qwen3.8-Flash base agent with the retrieved records added to its prompt. RAG-prompting uses the same memory as DeltaReplay, including the records of the task’s own template. At each step the model first summarizes the current page into a task intent, a page summary, and an app intent. The top 5 memory pages are retrieved by 0.35 × 0.35\times task-intent + 0.50 × +\,0.50\times page-summary + 0.15 × +\,0.15\times app-intent similarity; the page summaries and intents of memory pages were written by an LLM when memory was built. The model then infers the current subtask, and the top 5 recorded steps leaving those pages are retrieved by the similarity between the subtask and each step’s description. There is no threshold or memory gate, so records are added to the prompt at every step. Each record lists the step description written at recording time, the action description (including the recorded element index), the match similarity, the goal text of the source task, and its run, page, and step identifiers. The model picks one of the current candidate actions; if it picks none, or no subtask can be inferred, the base agent acts on the same candidate set.
paragraphs.zh: RAG提示工程。 Qwen3.8-Flash基础智能体，其提示中加入了检索到的记录。 RAG提示工程使用与DeltaReplay相同的记忆，包括任务自身模板的记录。 在每个步骤中，模型首先将当前页面总结为任务意图、页面摘要和应用程序意图。 通过以下相似度计算检索前5个记忆页面：0.35 × 0.35\times 任务意图 + 0.50 × +\,0.50\times 页面摘要 + 0.15 × +\,0.15\times 应用程序意图；记忆页面中的页面摘要和意图是在构建记忆时由LLM生成的。 接着，模型推断出当前子任务，并通过子任务与每个步骤描述之间的相似度，检索出包含这些页面的前5个已记录步骤。 没有阈值或记忆门控机制，因此每个步骤都会将记录添加到提示中。 每条记录都列出了记录时撰写的步骤描述、动作描述（包括记录的元素索引）、匹配相似度、源任务的目标文本，以及其运行、页面和步骤标识符。 模型从当前的候选动作中选择一项；如果未选择任何动作，或无法推断出子任务，则基础智能体将基于相同的候选集执行操作。

paragraphs.en: GUI-explorer. We adapt Xie et al. (2025) , which mines per-element knowledge by autonomous exploration, retrieves it by visual element patches, and ranks it with an MLLM: here transition-aware knowledge is mined from the recorded runs, retrieved for the current task and screen from the text UI tree, and injected into the action prompt of the Qwen3.8-Flash agent through the same candidate-action interface. The base agent and all baselines choose their actions from the same list of candidate actions generated from the UI tree. The knowledge comes from the same frozen memory as DeltaReplay: on AndroidWorld, 42 successful runs with 316 steps, each step becoming one entry. An entry holds the screen text before and after the step, the task description, the action type, and the step description that the recording agent wrote for that step, which serves as the function description. We replace the screenshot-based element retrieval of GUI-explorer with text retrieval over the UI tree: entries are ranked by 0.7 × 0.7\times page-text similarity + 0.3 × +\,0.3\times task similarity, and the action types and function descriptions of the top 5 are added to the prompt as a separate section. The adaptation also differs from the original method in two ways: the knowledge is mined from existing records rather than a separate exploration phase, and function descriptions reuse the recorded step descriptions rather than being distilled by a separate MLLM.
paragraphs.zh: GUI-explorer。我们对 Xie 等人（2025）的方法进行了改编：该方法通过自主探索挖掘单个元素的知识，通过视觉元素片段进行检索，并使用 MLLM 进行排序。在此方法中，过渡相关的知识从已记录的运行记录中挖掘出来，然后从文本 UI 树中为当前任务和屏幕检索知识，并通过相同的候选动作接口注入到 Qwen3.8-Flash 智能体的动作提示中。基础智能体及所有基线模型均从根据 UI 树生成的相同候选动作列表中选取动作。这些知识来自与 DeltaReplay 相同的冻结记忆：在 AndroidWorld 上，共有 42 次成功运行，总计 316 个步骤，每个步骤对应一条记录。每条记录包含该步骤执行前后的屏幕文本、任务描述、动作类型以及记录智能体为该步骤撰写的步骤描述（该描述用作函数说明）。我们将 GUI-explorer 中基于截图的元素检索方法替换为对 UI 树的文本检索：记录的排序依据为 0.7 × 页面文本相似度 + 0.3 × 任务相似度，并将排名前五条记录的動作类型和函数说明作为独立部分添加到提示中。这一改编还与原始方法存在两处不同：知识是从现有记录中挖掘的，而非通过独立的探索阶段获取；函数说明则直接复用已记录的步骤描述，而不是由另一个 MLLM 进行提炼生成。

paragraphs.en: All variants use Qwen3.8-Flash, the protocol of Table 2 , and the fixed task-set denominator. Full: Route A replays the record after a screen check, Route B re-grounds a recorded step by replacing the parameters it carries from the old task, and Route C lets the base agent act when memory offers no applicable step. Naive replay: the record is executed verbatim (recorded element indices and text), with no screen check, no grounding, and no parameter adaptation. w/o Route C: no base-agent fallback and no screen check; the best memory candidate is always executed, and the episode ends with a status-complete step when memory offers nothing (this terminating step calls no model and is not counted in A/B/C). w/o semantic matching: the screen check and the selector are both removed and only the target mapping is kept; the first borrowed step whose target element grounds on the current screen is executed without checking the screen or consulting the selector. The same-template ablations use all 22 tasks; the same-app ablation uses the first 30 of the 48 same-app tasks in a fixed order.
paragraphs.zh: 所有变体均使用 Qwen3.8-Flash、表 2 中的协议以及固定的任务集分母。 完整方案：路线 A 在屏幕检查后重播记录；路线 B 通过替换从旧任务中携带的参数，对已记录的步骤进行重新定位；路线 C 则在记忆无法提供适用步骤时，让基础智能体执行操作。 原始重播：记录被逐字执行（包括记录的元素索引和文本），且无屏幕检查、无定位、无参数适配。不含路线 C：无基础智能体兜底机制，也无屏幕检查；记忆中的最佳候选步骤始终会被执行，当记忆无法提供任何内容时，该回合将以一个状态为“完成”的步骤结束（此终止步骤不会调用模型，也不计入 A/B/C 中）。不含语义匹配：屏幕检查和选择器均被移除，仅保留目标映射；首个其目标元素能与当前屏幕建立关联的借用步骤将被执行，而无需检查屏幕或参考选择器。 相同模板消融实验使用全部 22 个任务；相同应用消融实验则按固定顺序使用 48 个相同应用任务中的前 30 个。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 gives the share of executed steps taken by each route in each coverage group of AndroidWorld-116 (Section 5.4 ). Steps borrowed from other tasks of the same app count as Route B: although they are executed as mapped, they are transferred to a task they were not recorded for, and only their operation is reused. Under Eq. ( 1 ) they are in the direct regime; counted as Route A, they would move the 10.1% of same-app steps from Route B to Route A.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 给出了 AndroidWorld-116（第 5.4 节）中每个覆盖组内，每条路线所执行步骤的占比。从同一应用的其他任务中借用而来的步骤被计为路线 B：尽管这些步骤是按照映射执行的，但它们被转移到了未记录它们所属的任务中，并且只有其操作被重复使用。根据公式 (1)，它们属于直接模式；如果将其计为路线 A，则会将 10.1% 的同一应用内步骤从路线 B 转移到路线 A。

paragraphs.en: We sampled 150 executed steps of DeltaReplay (Qwen3.8-Flash, AndroidWorld), 50 per route, with at most four steps per task for Routes A and B and two for Route C. The annotator, Claude Fable 5.1, was shown the goal, the screen before the action with the target marked, the screen after the action, and the action, and was blind to the route. It labeled each action correct (a sensible step toward the goal from that screen, or a correct completion or answer), incorrect , or unclear . Incorrect steps are split into no-ops (the screen did not change, e.g., because the target was clipped off-screen) and harmful actions (wrong element, content, or direction). Precision is the number of correct steps divided by the number of steps that could be judged. Route B mixes parameter-adapted replays (20 steps, 19 correct) and steps borrowed from another task’s record (30 steps, 20 correct). Table 8 reports the labels per route.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 DeltaReplay（Qwen3.8-Flash，AndroidWorld）中采样了 150 个已执行的步骤，每条路线各 50 个；其中路线 A 和 B 每个任务最多包含四个步骤，路线 C 则最多包含两个步骤。 标注员 Claude Fable 5.1 看到了目标、执行动作前的带有目标标记的屏幕、执行动作后的屏幕以及该动作本身，但对具体路线一无所知。 它将为每个动作标注为正确（从当前屏幕出发，朝着目标方向采取合理步骤，或完成正确操作或给出正确答案）、错误，或不明晰。 错误的步骤被细分为无效操作（屏幕未发生任何变化，例如因为目标被截出屏幕）和有害操作（选错元素、内容或方向）。 精确度等于正确步骤的数量除以可以被判断的步骤总数。 路线 B 混合了参数自适应的重播（20 个步骤，其中 19 个正确）以及从其他任务记录中借用的步骤（30 个步骤，其中 20 个正确）。 表 8 报告了每条路线的标注结果。

paragraphs.en: When correct matches do not hurt ( g ≥ 0 g\geq 0 ), negative transfer is bounded by the false-acceptance rate δ \delta . The ablations in Section 5.5 are consistent with this view: removing Route C or semantic matching raises δ \delta by forcing matches that should be rejected, and success falls below the base agent. These are idealized sufficient conditions, not guarantees that the prompted matching and selection modules satisfy them; they identify two testable requirements: executable grounding of a local correspondence and a low false-acceptance rate.
paragraphs.zh: 当正确匹配不会造成损害时（g ≥ 0），负迁移受错误接受率 δ 的限制。 第 5.5 节中的消融实验与此观点一致：移除路线 C 或语义匹配会因强制匹配本应被拒绝的项而提高 δ，同时成功率会低于基础智能体。 这些是理想化的充分条件，而非提示匹配与选择模块必然满足它们的保证；它们指出了两个可检验的要求：局部对应关系的可执行落地以及较低的错误接受率。
